notes.title: Demo Update 2.7 - Linux!
notes.content:
There's now a Linux build available!

The save folder now uses a local appdata folder instead of "Saved Games" folder in order to work with different platforms.

notes.title: Demo Update 2.6
notes.content:
- You can now call down the Prestige Panel even if you haven't unlocked it, so you can see what choices you've made before and what's still available
- Added a Wishlist button in Main Menu
- Added a link to our other game, "House of Mimics", to Main Menu
- Minor change to the ending (no more drop-down End Panel)
- Improved text in certain Tooltips
- Hour Level Highlighter is now in the correct position

notes.title: Demo Update 2.5
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
- "Crit Chance" tooltips now mention "Crit Multiplier" and vice versa
- "Hour Speed x3" unlock now affects the hour that's currently being collected
- "Secs/Mins Gained" and "Hours Gained" now say "+1"

[b]Balance Improvements:[/b]
- You can now unlock "Crit Multiplier" only after unlocking "Crit Chance"
- "Crit Chance" starts at 0% (previously 6%)
- You can now unlock "Hours Gained" only after you have every other upgrade

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Auto Minute SFX is no longer effected by clicks
- Dials no longer change each others' text
- No more upgrade handle zoomies
- Toggling Full Screen in the Menu saves current configuration
- No more forced Full Screen after Prestige
- All data now saves and loads correctly when quitting the game and coming back to it

notes.title: Demo Update 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Major Demo Overhaul[/h1]

We received critical feedback for the initial version of the demo, so we took that into account and overhauled it almost entirely.

The demo is now much more fun/satisfactory to play, has better balance, and progress-slowing elements have been removed.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

- Game is now more fun and satisfactory to play
- Better balance
- No more randomized second/minute collection
- No negative unlocks
- No biomass to block your progress
- Play 4 loops instead of 3
- Everything can be automated (including hour collection)
- Hour collection can be upgraded
- Critical "hits"
- Tooltips
- Fixed lots of little bugs
